title: deps(pin): move `.objectstack-sha` from the next.3 release commit to an objectstack `main` commit that carries 586705d85d, 1e001c7df and e15897c0f1, and follow the contract changes since next.3 (the first pin bump under ruling B on objectui#12955)
body:
Unblocked: objectstack-ai/objectui#12957 closed `completed` when PR #12963 merged as `749ed760`; re-derived with no new blocker (unlock comment below).

**Filing gate ④, a coordination node: one change unblocks several held cards.** It was split out of objectui#12957 by the seat's item 6 amendment (`6250606447`). Filed and dispatched by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0188TsgPV8kQXfuRuKmkj2ks`) on the maintainer's order 「你负责派发处理相关的issue，包括 objectstack 和 objectui 并测试确认。」. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why

objectui#12957 lands the pin mechanism with the first pin at `2c9bf9430a`, the `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.3` release commit. That pin deliberately reproduces npm `next.3`. This card makes the first real bump under ruling B. It moves the pin to an objectstack `main` commit that contains the three back-end halves whose front-end halves wait today:
- objectui#12932 (`586705d85d`, `emptyState` on bound record blocks);
- objectui#12929 (`1e001c7df`, `publishPackageDrafts` backfill);
- objectui#12484 (`e15897c0f1`, the approval request page's highlights).

All three are `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24168` today, the next.4 Version Packages PR. This card lets them go ahead without waiting for that release.

## Done when

1. `scripts/bump-objectstack.sh` moves `.objectstack-sha` to an objectstack `main` commit. `git merge-base --is-ancestor` proves that commit contains all three shas. `pnpm-lock.yaml` is regenerated by pnpm.
2. objectui follows every contract change between `2c9bf943` and the new pin, with no tolerant fallbacks. objectui#12957's dev measured the drift at `2ee5861`: 15 failing cases in 5 files. Re-measure them at the new pin:
   - `registry-inputs-spec-parity`: a new `list-view` row, counts 60→61 and 40→41, `marketplace:installed-list` retired, `emptyState`;
   - `block-config.test.ts`: `record:json` is no longer a spec `PageComponentType`, so the stale exclusion goes;
   - `record-highlights-layout-9187`: `emptyState`;
   - `spec-object-refinements-7715`: `checkPageRecordBindingPlacement`;
   - `ObjectTree.schemaTyped-8655`.
3. Each followed change is named in one changeset, with `Clause-②` read per change. A narrowed accept set reads `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and earns its contract review.
4. On landing, the seat re-points objectui#12932, #12929 and #12484 from objectstack-ai/objectstack#24168 to this card's merge, and releases them.
5. The two other consumers of objectui's pin keep their own order:
   - objectstack-ai/objectstack#24306 must land before objectstack's `.objectui-sha` moves past objectui#12957's merge;
   - objectstack-ai/cloud#3023 must land before cloud's `.objectui-sha` does.
   - Neither ordering is this card's to change.
